text: Pelulu
Adonius
Libarza

Huh? That's...
No way,  I never thought it would turn out like\nthis...
Whatever! Just go get me more samples, quick!
I wonder what they're doing.\nWelp, let's focus on our work for now!
Libarza, don't be ridiculous! I mean, how did the\nperson I asked to make sweets suddenly get\namnesia? I just don't get it!!
Don't ask me why, that's none of my business. If\nyou can't do it, you'll have to return the money\nI paid to you in advance. Is that okay with you?
Uh, that's...
The sweets that girl makes will be our trump card\nfor a comeback! If we can get back at the empire,\nyou may ask for as many extra rewards as you want.
Ugh...0-okay, fine!\nJust give me a little more time!
Huh? Only the man who looks like a scientist is\nhere now. That guy was with him earlier though.
We need to talk to him anyway.
Excuse me...\nDo you know where that fella, I mean Adonius is?
Tch! Did that stupid guy get caught? Well, I have\nno choice. It's still in the testing phase\nthough...This is your opponent!!
Oh my gosh?!\nW-what's that thing?!
Ugh...! I guess we have no choice but to fight\nit...I'll do my best to keep the surroundings\nsafe. Please handle that monster!
Ugh, well, it was an unfinished prototype after\nall, but still, this data is valuable too...\nAlright, bye!!
Hey!!\nYou can't just leave like that after picking a\nfight with us!
Please calm down, Pelulu.\nNow that he's gone, we're safe...
And I'm actually worried about Lefina.\nLet's head back for now!
